mapper.select: SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(c.id) AS contentId, c.title AS title, c.description AS description, GROUP_CONCAT(t.name ORDER BY t.name) AS tagNames, c.embedding_source_hash AS currentSourceHash, ce.model AS currentModel FROM contents c LEFT JOIN content_tags ct ON ct.content_id = c.id LEFT JOIN tags t ON t.id = ct.tag_id LEFT JOIN content_embeddings ce ON ce.content_id = c.id WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content_embeddings (content_id, vector, dims, model, created_at) VALUES ( UUID_TO_BIN(#{contentId}), #{vector}, #{dims}, #{model}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE vector = incoming.vector, dims = incoming.dims, model = incoming.model
mapper.update: UPDATE contents SET embedding_source_hash = #{hash} WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{contentId})
